explicitLimits: The grouped assistant query remains history-linear.
The safety-critical begin-Send and send-evidence observation path remains history-linear at 8004 assistant-selector matches/sample at 2000 turns.
No proof Ghost dominates total host-page lag.
Pixel-7 Playwright evidence is emulation, not physical Android certification.
Desktop Firefox evidence is not Firefox-Android/GeckoView certification.
Hosted-CI timing is not a calibrated low-end hardware budget.
priorRound.sequencingDecision: DQ-R4-LIFECYCLE-REVIEW and DQ-R5-LONGCHAT-REVIEW remain local under canonical Policy B. Independent reversible MOBILE-SHELL-STRUCTURAL work may continue.

roundHypotheses.claim: An adapter-owned explicit structural mount contract can add one Ghost child/sibling to a verified host row or stack with lower safety and maintenance risk than generic DOM inference.
roundHypotheses.prediction: A deterministic ChatGPT fixture plus live DOM capture can identify stable composer/action/footer anchors, preserve original Send identity, and survive host rerender with scoped observation.

roundHypotheses.claim: A reusable ancestor-climb and layout-classification algorithm may reduce adapter selector maintenance.
roundHypotheses.prediction: The same inference must choose the intended container despite hidden/secondary composers and nested control clusters; otherwise reject it for the first implementation.

roundHypotheses.claim: The existing fixed composer rail remains a compatibility fallback until structural verification succeeds.
roundHypotheses.prediction: Verification failure cleanly unmounts the structural attempt and leaves rail behavior intact without new actuation authority.

roundHypotheses.claim: A standard custom element with Shadow DOM may isolate Ghost internals while its host remains an in-flow child/sibling.
roundHypotheses.prediction: Isolation must not require fixed/absolute primary positioning, duplicate state/action authority, or scoped CustomElementRegistry dependencies.
